start_list.frame: model units, origin at registered tip, +z axis, retain beta>=0
start_list.status: record once as a shared W4 diagnostic; charge this evaluation and its admission outcome; no certified original numerical initial multiplier

start_list.generator: deterministicInitialQuadrics: ten SplitMix64 signed-unit draws per restart, set c[6] = -abs(c[6])-0.1 before fromUnnormalized, then normalize
start_list.restart_order: native indices 0..7 in generated order across all arms; no shuffling or new seed per timing repeat; halt on first qualified result or shared cap

arms.B: local numerical model and exact fallback
arms.C: frozen W5 ordinary predictor and exact correction

hardware: same physical host and single CPU core class for every paired run; record CPU model, memory cap, library versions, model/code/checkpoint hashes
warm_policy: Only immutable geometry preprocessing/encoding can be cached. Same option for every arm; report setup cost and cache policy. Reset solver state. No cached outputs/labels from prior trial.
adaptation: Log 2-step as a different secondary panel if sealed support records and held-out queries are disjoint and permitted; charge all support calls and wall time to the same cap.
accounting: Common wall-clock starts before per-arm setup, stops after independent final checks. Count attempted exact geometry requests including failed/backtracking/validation/adaptation. Stop at first cap; charge failed elapsed time. Log offline pretraining separately. Coordinate hints and up to eight native starts share one pair of caps. No fresh allocation per restart.
admission: W0 checked objective-specific solver termination and trusted final whole-body mesh
same registered geometry, units, tip, axis, minimum wall, connectivity, four physical checks
original Faster raw residual <=1e-12, relative physics <=1e-6 and mu>0; separate 90% problem requires its registered inequality and multiplier/complementarity gate

solution_quality.mass90: independently evaluated final mass divided by full original mass
solution_quality.scale: max(1,abs(A verified objective on same start and trial))

comparison: For each common ordered-start schedule, repeat and cache state: compare end-to-end time only after common physical and objective quality passes. A failure leaves speed ratio null. Report best independently feasible mass by both caps, all attempts and success counts. Do not average away failures.
partitions: Same parent geometry including all rotations/trajectories stays in one split; enforce contract_gate.audit_family_split, immutable approved hashes and separately sealed train/val/test permissions.

mass_continuation.first_point: common W4 diagnostic plus shared native ordered starts to solve 0.95; independent acceptance of that solution required
mass_continuation.second_point: each arm uses its own verified 0.95 solution first, then remaining authorized seed-0 fallback under the same total pair cap; do not restart the budget
mass_continuation.cost: same per-arm cap 600 s and 120 exact requests across the entire pair including 0.95 seed solve/cache/correction/failures; additionally report incremental cost to 0.90
mass_continuation.if_no_verified_previous_solution: mark continuation unavailable, account for attempts, no substitution

start_policy: W4 q is a common diagnostic. Use native seed-0 ordered starts for the primary solve; preserve admission/rejection records at every attempted start. All starts, restarts and diagnostics within one arm/repetition/condition share both caps.
